name: Accident statement · 3 vehicle B: policyholder, vehicle, insurer

fields.name: vehicle_b_policyholder_last_name
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 6 policyholder / insured ('Preneur d'assurance' / 'Verzekeringnemer'): surname ('Nom' / 'Naam').

fields.name: vehicle_b_policyholder_first_name
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 6: policyholder first name ('Prénom' / 'Voornaam').

fields.name: vehicle_b_policyholder_address
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 6: street and house number only, without postal code or city.

fields.name: vehicle_b_policyholder_postal_code
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 6: postal code, digits only.

fields.name: vehicle_b_policyholder_city
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 6: city or municipality.

fields.name: vehicle_b_policyholder_country
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 6: country as an ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. BE.

fields.name: vehicle_b_policyholder_phone
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 6: phone number or e-mail, as written.

fields.name: vehicle_b_vehicle_make_model
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 7 vehicle: make and model ('Marque, type' / 'Merk, type'), e.g. 'Volkswagen Golf'.

fields.name: vehicle_b_vehicle_plate
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 7: registration plate. Belgian plates look like 1-ABC-234; keep the dashes.

fields.name: vehicle_b_vehicle_registration_country
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 7: country of registration as ISO alpha-2, e.g. BE.

fields.name: vehicle_b_insurer_company
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 8 insurance company name ('Société d'assurance' / 'Verzekeringsonderneming').

fields.name: vehicle_b_insurer_policy_number
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 8: policy / contract number ('N° de contrat' / 'Polisnummer'), exactly as written.

fields.name: vehicle_b_insurer_green_card_number
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 8: green card number, exactly as written.

fields.name: vehicle_b_insurer_valid_from
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 8: first date of 'valid from / to' ('Valable du' / 'Geldig van'). Dates are written day/month/year.

fields.name: vehicle_b_insurer_valid_to
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 8: second date of 'valid from / to'. Dates are written day/month/year.

fields.name: vehicle_b_insurer_agency
fields.description: Vehicle B: the RIGHT column of the form (yellow, 'VÉHICULE B' / 'VOERTUIG B'). Box 8: agency, office or broker ('Agence, bureau, courtier' / 'Agentschap, kantoor, makelaar').

rules.name: Vehicle B policy number is present
Vehicle B plate read with confidence of 80 or more
